entities.summary: Bertoua is a city in Cameroon. It is the capital of the East Region of the Lom-et-Djerem Department. It has a population of 88,462, and is the traditional home of the Gbaya people. It is home to Mission Cameroon of Polish Dominican Order. Bertoua is a big city from Africa. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
